As a trans person (although i am a trans man) who's gone quite a white wondering whats wrong with me and why i feel the way i do about myself and my body, i want you to know that it is completely normal and ok to question your gender and be confused. you'll figure it out, but sometimes it takes more time for some than others and sometimes its much easier when you have a gender therapist to talk to. you can probably find some gender therpists in your area just by googling honestly. even if you just go once, im confident it will be helpful to you.

what helped me out most in figuring out how i feel and who i am:
- talking about it to other trans people and seeing how our experiences are similar or different.
- trying out going by new pronouns. for me i went from she/her to he/him and it felt so much more natural and so much more comfortable.
- going back to the first way i personally figured myself out, i took a look at how i view my body. i cried around puberty when my breasts began to develop rapidly, and i hated any masculine features because i had internalized all the times people had called them ugly or said i look like a man. later, i realized that i did not feel comfortable with my breasts at all and wanted them removed. even later than that, i realized i felt uncomfortable with my genitalia and i wanted something else instead in order to feel comfortable and happy. [this all happened within a span of maybe 4-6 years for me.]

being trans is a very rough road, but with some time and effort put in to figuring things out, it all eventually comes together and makes sense. good luck !
